scenicChapters.title: Going-to-the-Sun Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 35 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Going-to-the-Sun Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2026 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

going-to-the-sun-road.story: It goes by way of Lake McDonald Lodge, The Loop, Logan Pass and St Mary Lake. The highest point is about 2,050 m. Logan Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
